rawContent: Abuse 101 - my body and mind is not your property.  I'm not owned by you #abuse #sayno #suicideawareness #metoo

A new law on downsyndrom today, which is great milestone in gaining better equality in the world for people who are as human as anyone.  In the end, regardless of disability we are all capable, and non should be oppressed due to there circumstance. #MeToo

I think the worst thing about going through what I go through, is knowing tomorrow will be the same, and the next day, and in twenty more years.  And unlike a normal human who can escape severe abuse, I can't.  #metoo #abuse #badguys

I heard today I was a mug.  But I think that would be liked a lady being raped by ten guys, with no chance of defending herself, then been told she was a mug for letting it happen.  Pretty much.  #MeToo #freedomofthepress

Contrary to belief of my "haters" (yes I'm 43 and have haters) I'm on dating sites and looking for a lady around 30 and above. You tend to notice the age difference long term, so not interested in someone who just doesn't know what they want. Hope that clears that up. #metoo

After 15 yrs of hearing about the same woman every day. And spins on me being a nice idiot around her. In the end, if she did like me, now, I would probably puke and feel violated. Her icon has been used to abuse me for a very long time. 😔 there is no good ending here. #MeToo

Someone.  And I'm pretty sure it was a neighbour.  Seemed to walk by my door and shout something like "the f$^$^#, oh but he's disabled....  oh OK he's OK ya".  I mean.  I'm now feeling physically sick.  I am literly in my own home wtf  #MeToo
I have a opticians appointment  today.  Due to it being a prebooked occasion, I can't wait to see what delights will be ready and setup for the unwilling me.  Seatbelt on.  Ready for trauma. #MeToo

Do people think its OK to abuse someone, in general.  I mean if you were in a shop, or city or park.  And the staff were abusing you. Would that be OK?  Should the staff find it OK to do?  And why wouldn't they? #MeToo

I do ponder if you are victimised to the point of severe abuse with lies.  And you contemplate suicide by how it seems everywhere you go it happens.  Is this assisted suicide?  Or is it murder? #MeToo

When the abuse is bad. Like today. I've learnt to walk away, centered.  Knowing I'm not the same as them. Perhaps wise in my years. But calm also. I'm an ant too. And know what it's like to stand under that foot. I won't put someone else in the same position. #MeToo

I hear some terrible things while outside. But, away from the carefully woven illusion of happiness. Behind the veil. I'm proud and happy by the life I've lead. I feel ive helped enough people to know I deserve to breath your air. I'm OK with that. Even if it is alone. #MeToo

Contrary to popular belief of the "free" press. If being abused or hearing abuse in a shop, you can feel suicidal at the time, with a concern this could be your entire life.  But it doesn't mean you are indanger later of taking your own life when outside the situation. #MeToo
I sometimes wonder if one day, after all the trauma and abuse.  People will find me and I will be just staring off into space.  Noone home.  #MeToo #metooforever

After hearing deep abuse on my sky news. All I can say is looking back on my life so far. And all the unexplained. I would say 17 was no doubt ment to be this way. And no doubt preordained. But no, fate itself would surmise a act of god. And it wasn't a god who did this. #MeToo

If society told you to stop drinking coffee. And you were forced to due to the intense pressure. If your freedoms were stamped on by others, and human rights. And I guess privacy. After all, how many of us drink coffee? Are you of higher moral standards, or the oppressors. #MeToo

I'm 43. And have not dated in around 4 years. My most serious relationship recently was ten years ago. But I'm not desperate for emotional attachment. if I did date. It would be someone I knew I could trust. Not someone handed to me by my abusers.  #MeToo

Emotional abuse part 2322, playing a long running "scam" on the subject to dehumanise more, belittle, and use as a form of entertainment, making a fool of, while being gloated at and called a moran. #MeToo #si #abusedeverydayforentertainment
Is it normal that random people are added to my tik tok without my permission?  And I have to remove the follow later?  Even after changing password.  #woesofme #metoo

The hilarity of others spinning my obviously unwanted abuse and torment for 15 years, and surmising it as "look we will fire you" if you don't behave as we want.  I want it to end.  You see?  You are insane #MeToo

In terms of human rights.  If we simply pick just one of them.  Say...    right of privacy.  I'm OK with the police if they need to do there thing. But I'm not ok with the public acting like you live in a glass zoo cage. And then demanding you change. #MeToo

When I watch the news for an hour, is a stark reminder over why I enjoy my solitude. I'm not violent. Against anyone else or myself. Nor do I agree with any form of harm, verbal or otherwise, to others. I'm not like you. I'm happier being alone, than knowing people who do. #metoo

I sadly have had some bad "illness" the last week saying "I lied".  From various sources. This is of course difficult to quantify. Mark twain said. If you tell the truth you don't have to remember anything. And for me.  Evidence suggests I'm simply not a lying man.  #MeToo

Due to this "illness" and the abuse I recive, I don't expect to ever find a partner again or fall in love. The evidence supports that there are people who don't have my best of intentions and you can't form trust when they may only be there for there own gains. #MeToo

If your doing a activity.  And it's not for your own benefit.  Or others really in a charitable way.  And in fact, by participating it is causing you more psychological harm and abuse. Why do the activity? I've learnt over the years to simply walk away.  #MeToo

Some are simply people, alone, who find it as a nice outlet to a life of little love. As the bbc see schizophrenics as mad men who need to be sectioned before they murder. Not all who watch adult content, belive woman are below them. And still can remain respectful to all. #MeToo
I saw a program recently that featured a lady who escaped kidnapping after nearly 20 yrs. It touched me. I ponder after that long.  How did she even know it was wrong?  #MeToo https://t.co/hiKTYAYqVu
When you can't even trust the news in front of your own eyes.  What is there?  I trully do feel like will Smith in I am legend.  Totally alone.  #MeToo

Due to Omicron, I've canceled all plans for Xmas and decided to simply spend it with me, my cats, and of course my ghosts.  For the first year in a long time I feel quite content.  And given what I see from other people.  I'm very happy to spend it alone.  #MeToo

My life works backwards and wrong. If a vulnerable disabled woman, was abused, coerced and groomed by others privately for 15 years, would it be the woman's fault, or the abusers? If you change that woman to a disabled man.  It is me. I don't sleep well at night.  #MeToo

The overtly critical hate I've received recently for my jinx I made last year, is a sad reminder on why I don't enjoy showing work online anymore. And why I don't truly expect anything good to come of this life. #MeToo

I don't need a spin doctor to tell me what coercion and abuse is.  And how immoral it is in a society with a justice system. In the end, I'm certainly not desperate. I'm calm, in a very difficult situation that is not of my making. #MeToo

If someone is allowed to be abused.  And it's deemed...  a hilarity.  He.  Like me.  Is deemed a joke.  Then where is the end game? If authority allows it. And I cant speak about it since no one can help. The only option becomes what? There seems only one option left #MeToo

I only have two people in my life.  My mum and dad. I used to know alot more people.  But A illness that makes you feel like you have no privacy and anyone you go near may be threatened, or worse, tends to make you withdraw from people. So your left with just the brave. #metoo

I was diagnosed with schiz in 2006 put on the highest dose of anti psychotics, because it was that bad. It took 6 months to go outside. I learnt to work through the screams. And slowly, I gained back my sanity. Yet now, when I watch a TV, I still see myself as the joke. #MeToo

As well as schize. Ive had abuse in public,to threats down my phone. To sleeping with a knife near me and door barricaded. Because I was worried people wanted me dead. And I wanted it too. If it ment noone else was to be harmed. yet, if I turn on TV, I am still the joke. #Metoo

When I was diagnosed. I had to be looked after by parents. Before that I had lived alone, had a mortgage, married, even been the typical rock dude when 18 and always a bit drunk. But I got quite close to my family during this.  In the end most people don't stick around. #MeToo

This is basically basically analogy of my whole life - Plot idea: 97% of the world's scientists contrive an environmental crisis, but are exposed by a plucky band of billionaires & oil companies.  #metoo
People have died. I seem to have missed the joke here.  #MeToo

Its quite shocking that, if true, and that is always questionable with the news, this actor faked abuse. And cashed in on it. Everyday I go through severe abuse. But no, noone has charged me with faking.  #MeToo
https://t.co/QzOBcdeqLE

In terms of someone saying "grow up!" To do with your average daily life.  Firstly, I am a human being.  Not a robot. And choose what I want to do in my life. You don't choose, or should not choose, for me. This is also a legal right. I'm "allowed" to be me.  #metoo

In terms of being "schizophrenic" and always worried of the possibility of sectioning. a few years ago the law altered, so unless your violent against yourself or others, or unable to care for yourself, you can't be hospitalised. Ive seen it used as a "card" but it isn't. #MeToo

When you are not treated like a human being.  You begin to ponder if you are lower than everyone else. Can I handle it?  The only way out of severe abuse would be to end my own life. That is the end game. And something I don't want to consider. Could you handle it? #metoo

My "voices" or kidnapper,however you want to call it.  Once said to me, if it was one man doing this to me.  It would be murder.  But since its so many people now.  Its simply harassment. I don't deserve what you have done and do to me. #MeToo

Just if anyone wasn't aware. And if not God knows what you have been taught in school or the kind of life you have had, bad? But abusing someone, or gas lighting them. Is wrong. It leads to madness and suicide, it shouldn't be it seems part of normal culture. #metoo

I don't want people to feel sorry for me. It feels as patronising as the rest of this. But I do feel sorry for you. I was born with morals.  I grew up knowing right from wrong. What happened to you? #MeToo

I'm so thankful that I get to here about that one lady who I emailed my love too, every day, even though it was 15 years ago.  In fact every time I hear her name I feel sick and want to die now. I guess I don't need to worry about hell. It's here.  #MeToo

I wonder what is "enough" for everyone. As I have so often heard recently, as if I can stop my rape. If I snap? With the words 17 resounding in my mind in a pitiful rage. Or when I give in, and let go of this world. You give me no end. Only this. My destiny? I am abused. #MeToo

My favourite part of my day.  Isn't producing cool 3d. Or working passionately on things I enjoy.  It isn't my cats or walks in the park. It's being molested by a psychotic who needlessly abuses me through every media, clearly, why else would it do it? #MeToo

Is it good to show others you have "power"?  To me, having power, but using it with restraint is the act of a leader with a sound mental state. Feeling you are above others so much you can do anything, to show you have more. Is a dictatorship. And insane. #MeToo

Every day I hear another instance of subtly telling me how crap I am. Today's was how socks won't win you a million pound (I wrote a cute children's books entitled all for socks, it took 5 yrs) on sky news podcast. It feels to me like everyone DOES want me dead. #MeToo

In terms of success in life.  I don't belive in the lottery.  I believe alot of  work and many failures lead to success.  That is, if you don't have psychotics stopping you at every turn.  I work hard in everything I do.  Will I ever be successful? No. Because of you. #MeToo

Is my book "all for socks" by Adam vickerstaff, any good?  It's OK.  It was my first book, it took 5 yrs and alit of work, i self published, and due to my shyness and lack of marketing. It didn't manage to be profitable. But, the reviews were positive.  I'm not ashamed. #MeToo

"Turn Pen Time could see, made them try.  Yes he.  No more just being, but really see, made them try and not be scared, but then the dark come, they make decisions for them; take away what they scared of. Now dark controls everything, but the people, they ask for them." #MeToo

All I can say.  Is I have severe schizophrenia.  Im mentaly unwell and disabled. Because of you. I have to take powerful anti psychotics to live a life, with you. You seem to have made it your whole life, to ruin mine. My whole life,is to try and have my own life. #MeToo

I'm unsure why, but my insta seems to not be getting the same hashtag results as it used to. If I type in #tastymeals you would expect a billion hashtags.  Mine had about 5000.  Very unusual and it worries me I'm being censored again directly.  #Instagram #censorship #metoo

All I really can say.  Is I'm deeply sorry for telling people about criminal elements.  It felt the right thing to do. If you want me to lie, after all this time, and say I've never seen any bad guys, would you all stop abusing me?  Can I have my own life again? #metoo

I've been told by my abusers a few times the last few days.  Too "shut up".  I can whole heartedly say I won't. I belive, unless by law, I'm allowed to speak about whatever I feel, in public, or mostly, in private.  I won't stoop to the level of being abused into silence.  #MeToo
You know when I'm around, when a kid walks past you of eleven years old, and shouts out "if you slander, we will section!" God help the world when he grows up.   #MeToo

But due to my abusers who took up a torch against me. In the end I wish I never met her. But then. I also wish I had never worked in a casino, and told people about bad people. So. Was one email worth all the effort I see? No. Not at all. But people say the uk is corrupt! #MeToo

Just to iterate. I spoke up about very bad people before I asked out a cute lady. And asking her out and trying to woe her appears to now be the crime of the century, even though in law it isn't.  I'm not sure why.  But then.  People say the uk is corrupt.  #MeToo

Also to iterate. I am a pretty decent gent.i don't belive I've ever even harmed anyone.  In my life I've had 1 argument with a girlfriend. And I still remember it. And regret even that. I simply get abused from on high.  That seems to be my crime.  Being abused #MeToo

Just to iterate again.  I belive constantly reminding someone about a email, that he barely remembers himself, is kinda a bit coercive.  Alot. And to note also. Nothing bad was occurring like this in my life, until I said about bad people. It's kinda a bit sick itself. #MeToo

To be blunt.  We do make mistakes in life.  We all do. But I didn't need the muck thrown at me every day for 15 years.  I am a normal human being.  I make mistakes.  I'm fallable.  I learnt from it. And moved on, 15 years ago. It was not criminal. We are not nazis. #MeToo

I'm pretty certain we all have been stupid atleast once in our lives with a beautiful lady, or guy. Muck happens. It's normal. Kinda. When she said she wasn't interested. I walked on. It wasn't that big in terms of world events. 😕  feels like I'm stuck in tar. #MeToo

So. If its required.  I apologise to the world also for emailing this lady.  Who's brother I later helped save the life off, who's brother I later shaped his future into uni, and the other who I lived with. I'm sorry.  I wish I had never met them. #MeToo

I want to repeat. After 15 years of abuse nearly every day in media for being a idiot with a lady with a few emails once. And she was not offended either. I feel physically sick when she or them are ever mentioned. And have before thought of suicide due to the abuse. #MeToo

The lady in question I met in a club. She was out drinking. We flirted a little. I knew her family already.  I emailed her. It was a email.  It wasn't anything else.  It wasn't criminal.  It was a email.  It wasn't murder.  It was a email.  It wasn't rape. It was a email. #MeToo

I apologise again to the whole world.  I wish I had never told others about bad and powerful people. Since it seems by doing so, emailing this lady was one of the biggest events in UK history.  I lead a decent life and I wish I hadn't tried to do the right thing. #MeToo

I can't go out often. I get abused. I can't try online dating.  It appears hacked or something. I can't really watch the news. It's abusive sometimes. It's even hard going grocery shopping. Yes.  I deeply regret telling people about very bad guys.  I wish I hadn't. #metoo

I want to publicly appogise to the bbc and sky news and Gbnews.  I'm sorry for trying to tell people about what appeared to be organised criminal elements.  Could you forgive me and therefore not abuse me about emailing a lady 15 yrs ago, again please?  Sincerly #metoo

I want to publicly apologise also to the government.  I'm deeply sorry I tried to tell people about organised criminal elements it appeared.  I thought it might help.  And Im Sorry.  Could you also maybe stop abusing me about emailing a lady once. Who didn't really mind #metoo

To say again.  To the world.  I'm very deeply sorry for speaking out against criminals. Therefore would you mind stop abusing me about me emailing a very stunning lady who I had fallen for, like a idiot, 15 years ago. She forgave me.  Can you?  #MeToo

All I can say, is what I've learnt over the years. Is if you see crime. Be prepared to have your own life ruined if you speak up about it. It has mine. Decide for yourself on balance how much you care for others, in comparison to your self. Is it worth it? I wish I hadn't. #MeToo

However in terms of my own sensibility. I see gender, race, disability, etc, as the same. I am vegetarian due to my dislike of causing harm to others, even animals. Even in sadly fights, I defend, but not cause harm... I have never abused. And I enjoy helping others #metoo

Again, I'm very deeply sorry for trying to speak out against organised criminal elements. I was a fool. And just one man. And I certainly pay the price. I may never find love again. Or walk outside free  and safely. Even planning cinema to see matrix was too much a risk. #MeToo

If anyone at all believes anything good or effective has come out of my evil situation.  You are sadly miss informed. This is nothing but a  abusive and worthless hell, that I try and live through. It's been nothing more. #MeToo

Again.  I'm deeply sorry  for telling about organised crim....  oh sorry.  Sending a stupid email to a cute lady 15 years ago. That she didn't mind about. I will endeavour not to make any mistakes again in my life.  Since when I make any its Washington news. :/  #MeToo
So. Erm. I'm deeply sorry for telling bravely about organised crime many years ago and putting me in arms way. Now I can't actually go anywhere safely. So yes.  I wish I hadn't spoken out. #metoo

And yes. I'm deeply sorry for emailing a lady a silly email, saving her brothers life, getting another brother into university, taking her mum out to a ballet and meal, getting the other brother music lessons and living with him. I'm sorry. Again I wish I hadn't.  #MeToo

Morning all :) 😀  so it's the start of the morning. Another 17 in the news. Whomever this lady was (as said yesterday) she must have been a Kings daughter or something to be that trouble some. Least I didn't send nudes. #MeToo https://t.co/Add2uqXHKQ

I smell corruption like a fart in a car.
#Just17 #metoo https://t.co/TxaXXTv8gi

My abuse dudes said this morn it was "embarassing". You have abused me, left physical scars on me, and literly psychological tortured me for 15 years. Your worried about what I say back to you in my home that's is a bit embarrassing? Psychotic much? #MeToo

Just to let everyone know.  I've never "cyber flashed" (which should be illegal) well unless I was hacked against my will :/  🤔  but. I'm sure if anyone else did.  It wouldn't be in the news every day for 15 years in some way. Being me. :/ #beingme #MeToo

Would I email a silly email again to a lady? Well I've only done it once in my life. It was stupid and a bit love drunk. I wouldn't have done it again 15 years ago. So all I've learnt from the abuse from media, is don't tell authority's about criminals. #metoo

I have been told recently I'm inaccurate with my delusional ideas on criminals I've witnessed in my past.  However I want to point out.  I could gain 4 witnesses in half hour that would support the truth. More if required. Because its silenced, doesn't mean its a lie.  #metoo

Something so difficult in my life with this illness I have.  Is if I watch parliament (I like to stay in the know in politcs) I hear other people, sounding the same as the people talking, yet saying abuse in different ways. I have to try and zone out a little to listen. #metoo

I've been through very horrific times. I still go through them. And yet it doesn't make my life any more Important than a homeless person over Xmas, or a lady who was raped and is hoping for justice. I don't want to undermine myself. But we all deserve rights and justice. #MeToo

With what I go through.  I can't turn on a TV without hearing abuse, or radio. And if I go outside i have a similar issue.  So I'm faced with wondering if I'm basically a prisoner of the state, or a kidnap victim of 15 years. I do my best in the situation. But. It's wrong. #metoo

What makes people feel more entitled.  It's sort of OTTY, over the top, why? I work hard,am very skilled, yet someone that is say pretty, is shocked when something small happens. It's my life now. Every day a trauma happens. As people have said to me. Get used to it. #metoo

Sometimes I feel like Edmand Dantes.  Well, except that bit.  I don't do revenge.  But obviously I would love to see some justice to those who have deliberately harmed me.  Not for myself.  But so they can't do the same to others. Noone else should endure this. #MeToo

I guess the bbc only agree with human rights if its them 

I have not heard a real choir in about 8 years singing real Xmas songs.  One Xmas, 8 years ago, in the morning of xmas, I heard one on TV that was the last time.  No idea why that day though.

#MeToo

After not even been allowed to listen a choir, that was also full of abuse on BBC TV this morning.  I want to raise my head from the severe upset and trauma, and wish everyone who are kind and decent, a Merry Xmas. I hope your lives are better than mine x.  #MeToo

I just want to point out.  What I've done in my life that I'm abused with, is nothing that 90 % of the population had done themselves.  What is different, as always, is I'm Adam.  And I told on organised crime. They could have atleast given me Xmas. #MeToo

The sad thing about my mental illness is, it's basically like a man, hitting you every day, then demanding your are unwell, look your bleeding and dizzy, I will take you to hospital.  And you say no, I'm OK, so he hits you again, then says it again. It's sick #MeToo

Even though my life is similar to many woman and men in the world.  Appart from the abuse I receive.  I'm quite surprised how it seems, again, I've been abused down to the point of worrying about work and my own future, do to the actions of immoral people. #MeToo

I'm rather worried about my job prospects for future work given the public and aired abuse i see. It will no doubt ruin my changes at new work. I'm a 3d artist by trade.  I'm good at what I do. But sadly, with what I've heard today by immoral abusers, I wouldn't hire me. #metoo

I'm sure anyone who reads my tweets would know, and suspect they have been through abuse themselves.  That a abuser is not "clever" or more intelligent, to be able to abuse someone to sometimes near suicide. Yes they may be good at what they do. clever? More psychotic. #metoo

Do you enjoy abuse?  Do you enjoy abusing someone?  Do you enjoy hurting a human being who can't fight back?  If you do.  You are the psychotic.  Not me.  You are immoral.  Not I.  You are sick.  Not I.  You are the issue.  Not me.  It's you.  I'm just an ant. #metoo

My parents live in France. But every time I ring there is a man on my phone line who hurles subtle abuse to upset me. When my mum was very low and struggling, he even attempted to antagonise her. I am a good guy, yet psychotics seems to follow me around #MeToo

After 15 yrs of being abused every single day. When I hear my abusers on my phone line, or in my dubbed media, now a days I simply feel repulsed and kinda of molested. I picture a man with his trousers down hurling abuse into a mic. Hostage Adam? :( #MeToo

Contrary to seemingly new belief.  My book "all for socks" isn't pornography. It's a children's book.  For 12 years old or above to adults.  I would say younger but it has some deaths that made me feel uncomfortable recommending it to younger. Hope this clears that up. #MeToo

I just want to apologise to my haters. I also have wished I was dead. But I wish it had happened in 2006.  I'm just trying to make the best of the awkward situation of still being alive. I'm sorry. Don't worry you don't make it easy. #MeToo

I'm veggi. Ive saved peoples lives. I've saved old ladies locked out there home's. I've helped people through uni, got others into uni, every year I sponsor homeless people. I've stopped people who were suicidal. in fights I only defend and never harm. What is my legacy? #MeToo

I'm happy to be single me over Xmas this year. When anyone of any Importance in your life since 2004ish has been what seems there to bate you, you become less interested in the hope of finding a real lady. And instead are content with the honesty of cats.  #MeToo

I just want to be clear. Bullying and severe abuse, if not dealt with, leads to eventually suicide.  If you are being abused, find a way out of the situation, be it a refuge, family, friends, authority's. the same, if young, consider a teacher. But dont let it happen.  #MeToo

Since my tik tik on the subject got 4 views in comparison to each other post that was over 100.  I have a abuser on my phone, so I can't talk to family well. It seems my TV is dubbed. And coercive. I've woke with Injection marks and writing on my tache. I cant run. #MeToo

I don't know what it is with what I hear from government, or press, but to me they always seems to back the really bad dudes that I'm very aware are not good, are criminal and have ill moral character.  It's kinda frightening.  Is this me it does it connect? #MeToo

Due to popular belief.  I feel I need to say I don't actually have a learning disability.  I hear voices.  It's schizophrenia. However I can also photo it often.  So.  It might be evil $&#^ doing it instead. I have an iq of 139. And am always academically successful #MeToo

Someone implying someone is with learning disability, without proof. Whomever says that must have very low morals not to see that as abusing the other person. Diagnosed with a condition, ya sure. But not, then the perpetrator is simply a abuser. #MeToo

Since being gassed seems now to be a term for tired or something I'm going to use the term "abusing severely, making you lose all confidence in yourself, attempting to take over your life so you rely on them, and tricking you into questioning your own sanity" #MeToo

I hear music that relates to me quite often. in a way we all do. But. I wondered tonight if I was worth it. The effort. And in truth I don't think I am. I get abused regularly. And therefore I have my addictions and gripes. Im not the best I could have been. But I try #MeToo

I'm out shopping this morning.  Yes it's 4am.  But it avoids most abusers.  Bravely j didn't wear earphones when I entered the store.  I've got 2 items so far.  "SECTION HIM!" from a shelf stacker.  Earphones Adam.  Don't put yourself through them  #MeToo

If only you had an idea what damage you do with what you all say

#MeToo

Is there anyone even answering phones at vodaphone anymore? I've tried 4 times over the last few weeks.  And been on the phone for over an hour last week before giving up, due to being overcharged 17 pound a month.  Are they on strike? #MeToo

Just so everyone knows. Me with what I go through, being on the phone on hold for over an hour is psychologicaly damaging due to the abuse I hear through the line.  Every few seconds.  It's sick and so hard to cope with. 😪  #MeToo

Being on hold for vodaphone for 20 mins so far.  Other day was an hour .  Noone has picked up.  Are they on strike?  I would like to know why I'm being charged 17£ a month.  Its not my bill.  They won't pick up.  #MeToo #Vodafone

I was told by someone today I had rang the authority's about some of my issues. This is a lie. I am concerned that if I did call anyone like that, they might not "hear" me on the line. if I did communicate with authority's about the abuse, I would want to be accurate. #metoo

I have over the last 6 years had issues using phones. I use them of course. But sadly I feel it never gives a full impression of me, sometimes it almost seems a different personality. It works both ways, and I'm left preferring email or similar, unless speaking in person. #MeToo

One of the issues I have is others can't even see the issue of publicly abusing me and ignoring my human rights. I lose all confidence and rely on more addictive methods to cope, such as overworking.  I am only human, and my reactions are normal given the situations #MeToo

I've become a fan of breakfast bbc news recently. Sadly a few years ago I was hearing such accusations from "my" TV. While watching it, I one day smashed a TV in upset, feeling totally at a loss on what I could do. Because it wasn't the truth. #MeToo
